name: WIZARD
tagline: Read one book. Set everything on fire.
description: A stick-figure wizard drawn in black line. On his head sits a tall blue pointed hat, tip bent to the left, with 4 yellow dots and a wide flat brim. Round face: two small black eyes, one a slanted dash like a scowling brow, a bushy brown moustache, and a small open black mouth. Body is a single solid blue triangular robe, wider at the bottom. His left arm (viewer's left) sticks straight out horizontally, holding a closed black-outlined book with 2 visible covers. His right arm angles up and out, ending in 2 stubby fingers holding a big fireball: a red spiral orb at the base with tall red flames above it and orange zigzag flames inside. Two short black stick legs, both feet pointing to the right. Only colours: blue, yellow, brown, red, orange.
card: ATTACK  Bonk them with the book
SPECIAL  Throw the fireball, hold to grow
